race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: Those with experience do not set a high standard so newcomers may come to the fore. Before market clues, EL MUTAMAKEN , Al Lazzaz and Aziz Malak are preferred in that order. EL MUTAMAKEN (IRE) AL LAZZAZ (IRE) AZIZ MALAK (IRE)
